context: Answers to four asks: (1) curved lot fronts (A0247 court lot): the survey frontage measured along a curved front lot line is not used; keep the calculated frontage at the by-law measurement; survey preference stays for straight fronts. (2) Ward-code two-digit normalisation (parked patch d-ward-parked.patch, COA-D17, migration 280_coa_ward_two_digits.sql): bundle into the next CoA capture night rather than a dedicated one. (3) house_with_secondary_suite counts house_units = 2 (Planning Act s.35.1(1)(a), EXT-prov-1). (4) Fix the possible side-yard leak of newly keyed exceptions (117, 199, 245, 256, 258, 287; 155 (E), 340 (C)) onto garden and laneway suites with the M-267 / F-SC-7 unit_application pattern.

decisions.subject: Curved lot fronts: survey arc frontage
decisions.recommendation: Do not prefer a survey frontage measured along a curved front lot line; keep the calculated frontage. Survey preference stays for straight-fronted lots.

decisions.subject: Ward-code normalisation timing
decisions.recommendation: Bundle the parked ward two-digit fix and its backfill into the next CoA capture night.

decisions.subject: House with secondary suite unit count
decisions.recommendation: house_with_secondary_suite has house_units = 2 (Planning Act s.35.1(1)(a), EXT-prov-1).

decisions.subject: Suite side-yard leak from newly keyed exceptions
decisions.recommendation: Apply the M-267 / F-SC-7 unit_application pattern so exception side-yard figures bind the principal building, not garden or laneway suites, for the newly keyed exceptions.
